title: TC-CS-SRCR-Staff-Supply Chain and Third-Party Risk Management
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Staff – AI Third Party Risk Analyst (Third Party Security Assessment)**
**Experience: 1–4 Years**
**Role Summary**
The AI Third Party Risk Analyst is an entry-level role responsible for supporting the execution of Third-Party Security Assessments (TPSA) and Vendor Due Diligence processes. The analyst works within the Cyber Risk and Compliance team, applying foundational knowledge of third-party risk management (TPRM) frameworks, supply chain security principles, AI security for third parties and use of AI-enabled tools for Third Party Security Assessment. This role provides exposure to third party risk management lifecycle, onboarding assessment, and AI-assisted assessment & monitoring capabilities while building core competencies in cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and data-driven risk evaluation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end Third-Party Security Assessment (TPSA) activities including vendor intake, initial risk screening, assessor evaluation against industry specific standards/regulations and documentation of assessment findings.
* Assist in conducting vendor due diligence reviews by collecting, reviewing, and validating vendor-provided security evidence and questionnaire responses.
* Evaluate AI security practices of third parties wherever applicable.
* Participate in the risk assessment lifecycle from vendor onboarding through ongoing monitoring, escalation, and offboarding.
* Maintain and update TPRM risk registers, risk logs, and vendor risk profiles in GRC tools or risk management platforms.
* Support supply chain risk identification activities by flagging vendors with elevated exposure across IT, cloud, and operational domains.
* Assist senior team members in preparing risk assessment reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.
* Use and implement AI-enabled solutions for automated questionnaire/evidence analysis, gap identification, issue description and identification of risk treatment plans to accelerate risk evaluation.
* Track vendor remediation progress against identified control gaps and support follow-up activities.
* Maintain compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2 and more), and sector-specific requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of TPRM workflows, templates, and assessment methodologies.

**Education / Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technology, Business, Risk Management, or related discipline.
* Relevant certifications are advantageous (e.g., CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001 , ISO 42001, CISA, CISM, CISSP, other TPRM certifications).

**AI & Cyber Certifications**
**Cyber Security Certifications (Required / Advantageous):**

* CompTIA Security+ – Foundational cybersecurity knowledge covering threats, vulnerabilities, and risk management.
* ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation – Understanding of Information Security Management System (ISMS) principles.
* Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) – Entry-level awareness of IT/cyber risk concepts (pursuing).

**AI & Data Certifications:**

* Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) – Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts on cloud platforms.
* Google Cloud Digital Leader – Awareness of AI and cloud services applicable to risk assessment contexts.
* IBM AI Foundations for Business – Introduction to AI concepts including machine learning and automation.
* Coursera / edX AI for Everyone (Andrew Ng) – Broad awareness of AI applications in business and risk management.

**Skills & Experience**
**Required Skills:**

* 0–4 years of experience in cyber risk, third-party risk, information security, or related field.
* Basic understanding of Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) frameworks and vendor assessment processes.
* Familiarity with risk assessment lifecycle stages: identification, evaluation, mitigation, monitoring, and reporting.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, and CIS Controls.
* Knowledge of AI governance standards as ISO 42001. Understanding of AI security, especially in context of third-party security.
* Understanding of supply chain risk concepts including vendor tiering and dependency mapping.
* Ability to review and validate vendor security questionnaires (e.g., SIG, CAIQ, custom questionnaires).
* Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) for risk tracking and reporting.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and written communication skills.

**Good to Have Skills (including AI):**

* Exposure to GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, ProcessUnity) for risk tracking.
* Awareness of AI-enabled risk scoring tools and automated vendor intelligence platforms (e.g., BitSight, Security Scorecard, RiskRecon).
* Basic understanding of predictive modelling concepts applied to vendor risk prioritization.
* Familiarity with AI-driven questionnaire automation and NLP-based document analysis tools.
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as Excel Power Query, Power BI, or similar for risk dashboards.
* Interest in emerging AI technologies including machine learning applications in cyber risk management.
* Awareness of Graph AI concepts for mapping vendor relationships and supply chain dependencies.

**AI Tools Skillset**
**Vendor Risk & Scoring Tools:**

* BitSight / Security Scorecard / RiskRecon – Awareness and basic navigation for vendor cyber ratings and continuous monitoring signals.
* GRC Tools – Familiarity with vendor risk management workflow tools for questionnaire tracking and risk registers.

**GRC & Automation Platforms:**

* ServiceNow GRC – Basic usage for risk logging, vendor profiles, and assessment task management.
* Microsoft Power Automate – Introductory exposure to workflow automation for risk data collection and notifications.

**Data Analytics & Reporting:**

* Microsoft Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables) – Risk data aggregation, vendor scoring worksheets, and basic dashboard creation.
* Microsoft Power BI – Consuming pre-built risk dashboards and understanding risk KPIs.

**AI Awareness Tools:**

* ChatGPT / Microsoft Copilot – Basic use for summarizing vendor documentation, drafting risk findings, and accelerating report writing.
* Bing AI / Google Gemini – Research assistance for vendor background checks and regulatory lookups.

**Behavioral Expectations**

* Deliver assigned modules with quality and timeliness.
* Collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrate learning agility in AI and cyber risk domains.
* Support continuous improvement and automation initiatives.
* Show curiosity and proactively develop skills in AI-enabled risk management.
* Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive vendor information.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform end to end discovery of SSH keys, SSL/TLS certificates, and cryptographic assets across hybrid environments.
* Analyze key and certificate usage patterns, identify security gaps, and recommend remediation strategies.
* Support secure lifecycle management practices for SSH keys and SSL/TLS certificates, including rotation, revocation, and access controls.
* Conduct cryptographic discovery within applications, services, and infrastructure to identify cryptographic primitives and algorithms in use.
* Assess cryptographic posture and readiness of systems and applications against emerging quantum computing threats.
* Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to evaluate and implement quantum safe cryptographic solutions.
* Contribute to the development of security documentation, standards, and operational procedures.

* Experience in discovery, assessment, and management of enterprise cryptographic assets.
* Familiarity with Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), including an understanding of quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms, emerging standards, migration considerations, and their impact on enterprise PKI and security architectures.
* Strong understanding of cryptographic principles, PKI, SSL/TLS, SSH, and trust models.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix/Windows administration, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and automation.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and native key/certificate services.
* Strong communication, analytical, and collaboration skills.

title: Digital Workplace Administrator

The administrator will work across IT teams, business stakeholders, and global users to maintain Microsoft 365 services, support messaging and collaboration platforms, automate administrative processes, troubleshoot operational issues, and contribute to service improvements. The role requires a proactive approach to operations, a strong automation mindset, and a commitment to service reliability, security, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Success in this role will be demonstrated through stable and secure Microsoft 365 operations, effective automation of administrative tasks, reliable mail and collaboration services, timely incident resolution, well-maintained documentation, and continuous enhancement of the end-user experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Administer, monitor, maintain, improve Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online and Microsoft Teams and related platforms.

* Maintain secure configurations, policies, and access controls; monitor issues and address risks.

* Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online policies and integrations.

* Working knowledge of mail flow, DNS records, directory synchronization, and troubleshooting associated identity and messaging services.

* Experience using GitHub or a similar platform to manage scripts and automation.
* Understanding of service desk operations and ITIL practices.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize operational needs, and take initiative in improving services.

* Understanding of the Big 4 workplace culture and business structure
* Conduct interview skills with investigative mind-set, supporting GCO from a technical perspective

Some weekend work should be expected
  
  
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Education:**
Bachelor or Master Degree in Computer Science or a related field
  
  
Experience:
  
  
5-10 years of experience in one or more of the following:
  
  

* Information Security, demonstrating experience in investigative unit and incident response.
* Information Security, in depth understanding of cyber investigation, forensic tools, and methodologies, including: log correlation and analysis, forensically handling electronic data, knowledge of the computer security investigative processes
* Be familiar with a basic understanding of legalities surrounding discovery and analysis of electronically stored information
* Experience with Forensic tools such as Nuix, Axiom, and others.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender and other monitoring tools
* Familiar with Microsoft environment (Exchange, SharePoint, Purview , Sentinel, Azure…)

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen.
  
  
Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As EY accelerates the adoption of Frontier AI, Generative AI, AI Agents, and Autonomous Workflows, identity has become a critical security control for protecting enterprise systems, data, and digital assets. AI-powered solutions increasingly access sensitive information, interact with business applications, make decisions, and execute actions on behalf of users, creating new and complex identity security challenges.
  
  
The IAM Secure Access Engineer will be responsible for designing, governing, and securing AI identities, agent permissions, and access controls across the organization. This role will help establish mature security frameworks that align with Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance standards. By providing dedicated expertise in AI-focused identity security, this position will play a key role in reducing organizational risk, strengthening compliance, and enabling the safe, scalable adoption of AI technologies across EY.
  
  
The role combines traditional IAM engineering fundamentals with delivery of new Secure Access initiatives across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta, PlainID, multifactor authentication, passwordless authentication, workload identities, token protection and secrets or certificate-based authentication.
  
  
The engineer will work with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams and vendors to translate requirements into secure, supportable solutions and move changes through design, build, test, production deployment and operational handover.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**AI Identity Governance & Security**

* Design, implement, and maintain identity governance frameworks for AI agents, machine identities, autonomous workflows, and Generative AI platforms.
* Establish lifecycle management processes for AI identities, including provisioning, credential management, authentication, authorization, and deprovisioning.
* Define and enforce policies governing AI agent access to enterprise systems, applications, APIs, and sensitive data.
* Develop controls to ensure AI systems operate within approved permissions and business boundaries.

**Authentication, Federation & Access Engineering**

* Design, configure and support authentication and federation integrations using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and related standards.
* Implement and maintain MFA, single sign-on, passwordless authentication and risk-based access controls.
* Configure and troubleshoot PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta and Microsoft Entra ID integrations.
* Support onboarding and migration of applications to modern authentication patterns.
* Analyze authentication failures, policy conflicts, token issues and user access problems across integrated platforms.

**Conditional Access & Identity Protection**

* Implement and enhance Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies, authentication strengths, authentication contexts and protected actions.
* Support Continuous Access Evaluation, token protection, sign-in risk controls and secure administrative access patterns.
* Assess policy impact, exclusions, break-glass requirements and deployment risks before production release.
* Use logs and platform telemetry to validate control effectiveness and investigate access issues.

**Authorization, Workload Identity & Secrets**

* Implement policy-based authorization using PlainID or comparable authorization platforms.
* Support role-based, attribute-based and policy-based access control patterns.
* Improve security for service principals, managed identities, application identities and other non-human identities.
* Support migration from shared secrets to managed identity, certificates or approved vault-based patterns.
* Coordinate certificate, key and secret lifecycle activities with PKI, vault and application teams.

**Engineering Delivery & Operations**

* Create technical designs, implementation plans, test cases, rollback plans and operational documentation.
* Raise and manage Change Requests and support production deployments through established controls.
* Automate repeatable administration and validation tasks using PowerShell, REST APIs or other approved scripting methods.
* Perform unit, integration, regression and security testing and support post-deployment validation.
* Participate in incident, problem, vulnerability remediation and continual improvement activities.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Solid understanding of authentication, authorization, identity federation, MFA, SSO and Zero Trust principles.
* Hands-on experience with at least two of the following: Microsoft Entra ID, PingID, PingFederate, PingAccess, Okta or PlainID.
* Working knowledge of SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos and RADIUS.
* Experience with Conditional Access, Identity Protection, workload identities or modern authentication controls.
* PowerShell or comparable scripting experience and the ability to work with REST APIs, JSON and certificates.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, testing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Understanding of secure software delivery, ITSM, Change Management and production support practices.

**To qualify for the role you must have**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in IAM, authentication engineering, access management, security engineering or enterprise platform support.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI/CD.
* Experience creating deployment pipelines and release automation.
* Basic containerization knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
* Experience configuring or supporting enterprise authentication and access management solutions.
* Experience delivering controlled changes across development, test and production environments.
* Ability to analyze technical issues, document findings and work effectively with distributed teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra Conditional Access, Ping Identity products, Okta or PlainID.
* Knowledge of passwordless authentication, FIDO2, certificate-based authentication and PKI.
* Experience with CyberArk, Azure Key Vault or another enterprise secrets platform.
* Cloud platform knowledge in Azure and familiarity with CI/CD or infrastructure automation.
* Relevant Microsoft, Ping Identity, Okta, security or ITIL certification.

**What We Look For**
We look for a hands-on engineer who combines sound IAM fundamentals with curiosity about emerging authentication and authorization controls. The successful candidate is structured, security-minded and comfortable collaborating across application, infrastructure, architecture and operations teams.
  
  
**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The benefits package focuses on physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can explain the benefits available in your country.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Associate Consultant – ICT, AV & Security
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior ICT, AV & Security Consultant to join our team in Kochi, India.

The successful candidate will lead and deliver ICT, Audio Visual (AV), Security, and Extra Low Voltage (ELV) design and consultancy services across a diverse range of projects. This role involves developing coordinated technical designs, managing project deliverables, providing technical guidance to engineering teams, and working closely with architects, engineers, developers, contractors, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality, compliant, and innovative solutions.

The ideal candidate will have 13–15 years of relevant design consultancy experience, strong technical expertise across ICT and ELV systems, and proven leadership skills in managing teams and coordinating multidisciplinary projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and deliver ICT, AV, Security, and ELV design and consultancy services across projects.
* Develop design concepts, drawings, specifications, equipment schedules, calculations, and technical documentation.
* Review architectural, MEP, and engineering drawings to ensure coordinated and integrated system designs.
* Develop, review, and manage BIM models for ICT, AV, Security, and ELV systems.
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination, clash detection, and constructability reviews.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, clients, and other project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Conduct technical reviews, site inspections, and design assessments, and respond to technical queries.
* Prepare and review tender documentation, technical submissions, specifications, and project deliverables.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards, regulations, authority requirements, and client specifications.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineers, supporting the resolution of complex design and coordination issues.
* Lead, supervise, and mentor engineering teams, ensuring the quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of project deliverables.
* Manage project workloads, allocate resources, and monitor team performance to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Attend client meetings, deliver technical presentations, and provide professional advice and recommendations.
* Support the professional development of team members through technical training, knowledge sharing, and guidance on design practices, tools, standards, and company procedures.

**Techinal Scope**

* ICT / Data and Network Infrastructure
* Structured Cabling and Wireless Network Systems
* CCTV / Video Surveillance Systems
* Access Control and Intrusion Detection Systems
* Intercom and Video Intercom Systems
* Audio Visual (AV) Systems
* Smart Building / IoT Systems
* Extra Low Voltage (ELV) Infrastructure
* Multidisciplinary Design Coordination
* Design Drawings, Specifications, and Equipment Schedules
* Tender Documentation and Technical Submissions
* BIM Coordination, Clash Detection, and Constructability Reviews
* Application of Relevant Standards, Regulations, and Industry Guidelines

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* 13–15 years of relevant experience in ICT, AV, Security, and ELV design consultancy.
* Strong technical knowledge of ICT infrastructure, structured cabling, security systems, AV systems, and integrated ELV solutions.
* Proven experience in leading engineering teams and managing design deliverables across multiple projects.
* Strong understanding of BIM workflows, multidisciplinary coordination, and clash detection processes.
* Experience in preparing design reports, technical specifications, tender documents, and detailed engineering drawings.
* Familiarity with applicable international standards, local regulations, authority requirements, and industry best practices.
* Experience working on Middle East projects is highly desirable.
* Excellent technical report-writing, communication, client management, and presentation skills.
* Strong project management, resource planning, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain high standards of technical quality.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
* Exposure to diverse and high-profile projects.
* A collaborative and supportive working environment.
* Opportunities to lead technical teams and contribute to the growth of the business.
* Career progression within a growing consultancy organization.

**How to apply**

Interested candidates should submit their CV and a short cover letter outlining their relevant experience, qualifications, technical expertise, and key project portfolio to heyhr@designconfidence.me.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work closely with clients and delivery teams to translate IAM challenges into practical, scalable, and reusable AI-enabled solutions. The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of IAM experience, AI awareness, solution design capability, and stakeholder-facing communication skills. This profile is expected to guide discovery, define the IAM-AI vision, support PoCs and MVPs, and help clients adopt intelligent, risk-aware, and secure identity operations without losing focus on control, auditability, and business value.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical architecture & design**

* Define IAM-AI solution architecture across IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, directory services, NHI, and security operations use cases.
* Translate client IAM challenges into scalable AI-enabled workflows, PoCs, MVPs, and implementation roadmaps.
* Guide secure integration of identity data, AI models, automation scripts, APIs, analytics, and cloud services to improve IAM operations and risk visibility.
* Provide hands-on direction using Python, PowerShell, APIs, and automation patterns to validate and accelerate solution delivery.

**LLM, Reasoning & Knowledge Engineering**

* Design AI-led IAM use cases using LLMs, RAG, agents, copilots, orchestration frameworks, and responsible AI guardrails.
* Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.
* Support secure NHI and agent identity governance covering discovery, inventory, authentication, authorization, and guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.
* Shape PAM automation and analytics across CyberArk, privileged access patterns, session monitoring, password rotation, secrets, and risk-based remediation.
* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.
* Strong understanding of IAM domains including IGA, AM/SSO, PAM, AD/Entra ID, NHI, lifecycle management, governance, provisioning, access reviews, and risk scoring.
* Working knowledge of AI concepts such as LLMs, RAG, AI agents, copilots, orchestration, embeddings, and cloud AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Big 4, GDS, global delivery, or consulting-led environments.
* Ability to create PoC/MVP plans, architecture views, roadmap slides, executive summaries, and client demos.
* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
* Relevant working knowledge or certifications across CISSP, CISM, Azure AI, Google ML, Saviynt, SailPoint, CyberArk, or cloud security are preferred.

**Certifications, Compliance & Assurance**

* Ensure IAM-AI solutions are secure, auditable, explainable, and aligned with client risk, compliance, and assurance expectations.
* Define governance guardrails for AI-driven identity operations, NHI controls, privileged access automation, access recommendations, data handling, and model-assisted decisions.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: Senior Audit Analyst
description:
**Job Overview**
Hubbell Incorporated is a best-in-class provider of Utility and Electrical solutions that enable customers to operate critical infrastructure Reliably and Efficiently. We Empower and Energize communities through innovative solutions in Front of and Behind the Meter.
  
  
Join us as we pursue creating a more sustainable company and future for our customers and value chain. We are looking for a Senior IT Audit Analyst to provide support for testing and reporting on IT general controls. A great role for a professional with a background in data analysis, data science, IT audit and/or IT security assurance.
  
  
A Day In The Life
  
  
**Responsibilities**
You will be supporting Hubbell Internal Audit by testing and reporting on IT general controls. Technical skills to understand IT control testing from various technologies including – SAP, other ERPs, Azure, Aws, Cybersecurity and conduct end-end test work are required. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Work with Internal Audit and stakeholders to execute IT audit procedures.
* Assist with annual Sarbanes Oxley (SOX) IT audits and other audits as assigned.
* Develop workpapers for planning, fieldwork and reporting phases.
* Retrieve data independently from SAP, other applications and tools to analyse, test and report.
* Proficient in Microsoft tools, especially Excel, Word and PowerBi.
* Lead process understanding walkthroughs and document IT process understanding.
* Execute controls testing and provide daily status update.
* Participate in reporting phase and update Audit tools to document test results.
* Conduct issue remediation reviews.
* Identify opportunities of improvement to deliver quality work and continuous audit approach.

What will help you thrive in this role?
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Have The Following Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, or related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant technology audit experience.
* Advanced knowledge of working with MS Excel. Working knowledge of SAP ERP.
* Active CISA or other relevant certificates from ISACA or other reputed institutes.
* Detail oriented, analytical, quality obsessed with excellent communication skills.
* Experience working in global teams and available to overlap EST time zone work hours.
* Experience working in team environments with technical and non-technical users.
* Self-motivated with excellent time management to work on multiple projects simultaneously.

**Hubbell Incorporated**
Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.
  
  
The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.
  
  
We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.
  
  
**Hubbell Unified Business Solutions**
Hubbell Unified Business Services (HUBS) provides corporate shared services to support all businesses across the enterprise. Functional areas include Engineering, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, Human Resources, Payroll, Environmental Health & Safety, and Compliance. HUBS employees are located around the world.
  
  
Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.
  
  
The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

title: CMS-Senior-Incident Orchestrator
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The Incident Orchestrator is responsible for coordinating, driving, and governing the execution of security incidents identified by the SOC. The role ensures that incidents are triaged correctly, escalated appropriately, and resolved within defined SLAs, acting as the central coordination point between SOC analysts, threat detection teams, IT responders, and incident response leadership.
  
  
The role operates in accordance with the enterprise Incident Response Plan and Policy, supporting structured, repeatable, and auditable incident handling
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end to end coordination of security incidents from initial escalation through containment, remediation, and closure.
* Act as the single point of coordination between L1/L2 SOC analysts, threat detection teams, IT teams, and incident response stakeholders
* Ensure incidents are classified, prioritized, and handled in line with the approved Incident Response Policy and severity model
* Validate escalated alerts and incidents to confirm true positives and business impact before response actions are initiated
* Drive containment and mitigation actions by coordinating with relevant resolver groups (endpoint, network, identity, cloud, etc.)
* Manage incident bridges / war rooms during major incidents, ensuring clear ownership and timely updates.
* Ensure all incident activities are accurately documented in the designated incident management / ticketing platform
* Prepare and deliver incident status updates, timelines, and summaries for SOC leadership and stakeholders.
* Support post incident reviews (PIRs) by compiling evidence, timelines, and response effectiveness inputs.
* Ensure SOC incident handling follows defined playbooks, runbooks, and SOPs.
* Identify process gaps, recurring issues, and response inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to SOC and IR leadership
* Act as an escalation point for complex or ambiguous incidents that require senior operational judgment.
* Review and improve incident response processes and playbooks.
* Participate and/or lead incident response calls.
* Participate in post-incident reviews to assess the effectiveness of the response and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to lower-level incident responders.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Experience with digital forensics tools and techniques to investigate incidents.
* Proficient in utilizing SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, LogScale, Google Chronicle, IBM QRadar, or equivalent tools for effective incident response and analysis.
* Experienced in leveraging EDR/XDR solutions like CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XSIAM, Carbon Black, or similar platforms
* Understanding of security principles, techniques, and technologies such as SANS Top 20 Critical Security Controls and OWASP Top 10
* Understanding of attack lifecycles and incident response phases (identify, contain, eradicate, recover).
* In-depth knowledge of network protocols, operating systems, and security technologies.
* Proficiency in incident detection and response tools
* Familiarity with malware analysis and reverse engineering.
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating tasks and processes.
* Ideal candidate will have 5+ years of security related experience in areas such Security Operations, Incident Response, and Forensic Investigation.
* Analytical mindset & has the aptitude to learn on the fly.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 operations center (shift work required)
* Strong problem-solving abilities to analyze complex incidents.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Bachelor’s Degree relevant to Information Technology
* Related Certification such as CEH, CHFI, Sec+, ITILv3, GCFA, ECIH, GCIH, CySA+, etc

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

As part of our EY Cyber Risk and Compliance Consulting (CRCR) team, you will contribute technically to Cyber Security client engagements and internal projects. The role involves managing Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPCRM) engagements, ensuring that our clients effectively identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with third-party relationships. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for TPCRM Senior with expertise in cyber security, risk management, and security controls testing concepts. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of our TPCRM service offering while upholding EY’s commitment to quality and excellence. In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you will confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards. To assist in the delivery of third-party risk management engagements. This includes:
  
  

* Risk Assessment and Management: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments of third-party vendors to identify potential risks and vulnerabilities. Draft and explain risk mitigation strategies to minimize exposure to third-party risks.
* Policy Development and Compliance: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop or update third-party risk management policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to third-party engagements.
* Third Party Due Diligence: Oversee the third-party due diligence process, including cyber, privacy, resiliency and compliance assessments.

Explain Risk/Findings or other assessment related deliverables to client stakeholders. Facilitate communication and training on third-party risk management best practices across the organization.
* Reporting and Analytics: Prepare and present regular reports on third-party risk exposure and management activities to client senior leadership. Utilize data analytics to identify trends and areas for improvement in third-party risk management processes.
* Incident Management: Lead investigations into third-party incidents and breaches, ensuring appropriate corrective actions are taken. Maintain an incident response plan specific to third-party risks.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about industry trends, emerging risks, and best practices in third-party risk management. Recommend enhancements to the third-party risk management framework based on evolving business needs and regulatory changes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Cyber Security Skills: Around 4-6 years of experience with key components of Cyber Security including (but not limited to):

+ Third Party Risk Management (End to end TPCRM lifecycle)
+ Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance
+ Cyber Strategy & Transformation
+ Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
+ Basic knowledge of general security concepts, including defence-in-depth, least privilege, security architecture and design, networking, architecture reviews, VAPT, IDS/IPS technologies, SIEM, and resiliency concepts such as business continuity and workplace safety.

* TPCRM Skills: Experience in client-facing roles, managing cyber security and resiliency-based third-party risk assessments from start to finish. Ability to lead third-party assessments, providing technical guidance to assessors and facilitating decision-making during evidence reviews.
* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze complex data and risk factors to make informed decisions regarding third-party relationships.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail in assessing vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance requirements to ensure thorough evaluations.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey risk assessments and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.

* Interpersonal Skills: Strong relationship-building skills to foster collaboration with internal teams and external vendors, ensuring alignment on risk management objectives.
* Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Regulatory Knowledge: In-depth understanding of relevant regulations and compliance requirements related to third-party risk management, including data privacy and security standards such as ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST, GDPR, CCPA, COBIT, OWASP Top 10 etc.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with risk management software and tools, as well as proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., GRC enablement solutions, such as Process Unity, Prevalent, Archer, ServiceNow, etc.).
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing business environments and evolving regulatory landscapes, demonstrating flexibility in approach and mindset.
* Leadership Qualities: Strong leadership skills to guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of risk awareness and compliance within the organization.

**Qualify for the role, you must have.**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer/ electrical engineering, information technology or a related field
* At least 4 years of relevant experience cyber security and Third-Party Risk Management
* One mandatory certification - CISSP, CISA, CISM, CTPRP, CTPRA, CIPP
* Knowledge of TPCRM tools like OneTrust, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Archer along with external data providers like SecurityScorecard, BitSight, etc.

+ Operations Security

+ Third Party Relationships

title: Sr. DevSecOps Engineer
description:
2Base Technologies is a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience. We work as an enterprise solutions partner for clients in the United Kingdom, the United States, India and other markets, building web and mobile applications and end-to-end digital solutions across industries.

We are adding a Senior DevSecOps Engineer to our DevSecOps team. You will strengthen our security posture, mature our pipelines and automation, and help the team build secure-by-design practice across everything we deliver. Depending on experience, this role can step into the lead position for the team or grow into it.

Key Responsibilities

Define, implement, and enforce security standards, policies, and best practices across cloud and on-prem environments.

Conduct security risk assessments, perform vulnerability scans, coordinate penetration testing activities, and execute mitigation plans.

Architect, maintain, and enhance secure CI/CD pipelines with automated compliance and governance checkpoints.

Promote and uphold a strong “Security First” culture across engineering, ensuring secure design and development practices.

Continuously monitor, detect, investigate, and respond to security threats, incidents, breaches, and anomalies.

Develop, own, and mature automation practices: infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and configuration management using Ansible, alongside other automation frameworks.

Design and maintain secure cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, or GCP to support scalable and compliant deployments.

Build, operate, and secure containerized environments using Docker, with enforced security baselines. Kubernetes where applicable to the project.

Implement and maintain secure monitoring, logging, and alerting systems for infrastructure and application layers, extending to SIEM as the practice develops.

Improve and optimize system reliability, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance across all critical workloads.

Mentor, guide, and upskill DevOps engineers in secure development, automation, and operational excellence.

Lead technical strategy, decision-making, tool selection, process improvements, and DevSecOps roadmap execution.

Work closely with PMO and engineering teams so that security, performance and delivery objectives stay aligned.

Operational Ownership

Backup and disaster recovery: Backup policies, regular tested restoration, and disaster recovery plans with agreed recovery time and data loss targets, with restoration tested rather than assumed.

Release management: Deployments across development, staging and production, including approvals, rollback procedures, and troubleshooting failed releases.

Access and secrets management: Access reviews, joiner and leaver access, service accounts, credentials, secrets rotation, and encryption keys.

Pipeline security: Code, dependency, container image, secrets and Infrastructure-as-Code scanning built into CI/CD, with clear ownership of who fixes what and by when.

Incident management: Leading production incident response, coordinating updates to the people who need them, running root cause reviews, and tracking corrective actions to closure.

Cloud cost management: Monitoring cloud spend, investigating unexpected cost, and improving resource sizing and utilisation without affecting reliability.

Documentation: Infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment guides, operational runbooks and recovery procedures, maintained as the environment changes.

Reliability measurement: Defining and tracking service availability, deployment failure rate, recovery time, and how long vulnerabilities take to close.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

6–10 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure engineering, including at least 4 years hands-on in DevOps, with strong security exposure.

Strong hands-on expertise in AWS, with a focus on secure architecture.

Deep experience with at least one CI/CD platform, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines. Breadth across several is useful; depth in one is required.

Experience securing and running Docker containers in production.

Experience independently owning production infrastructure, releases and incident resolution, demonstrated through the work you have led.

Strong understanding of networking technologies: LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPN, load balancers.

Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (OWASP, NIST, CIS Benchmarks).

Working depth in at least one monitoring and logging stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, or CloudWatch.

Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Shell).

Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence engineering teams.

Tools and Technology

These are the areas you will be working in. Core areas are assessed during the interview process. Additional areas strengthen an application, and support is available to develop them in the role.

AWS: Hands-on work across compute, storage, networking, access management and cost, based on environments you have configured.

CI/CD: Building and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Bitbucket Pipelines, including the security checks within them. Depth in one platform is sufficient.

Git: Version control in practice: branching strategy, merge and release flow, repository access control, and keeping credentials out of version history.

Cloud server administration: Provisioning, sizing, lifecycle and cost of the servers behind the applications, in the cloud and on-premise where it applies.

Ubuntu: Ubuntu Server administration at an operational standard: packages, services, storage, networking, DNS, TLS and permissions.

Monitoring tools: Prometheus and Grafana, the ELK stack, CloudWatch or an equivalent, implemented by you, with judgement about alert severity. Depth in one stack is sufficient.

Server security: Hardening, patching, firewall and SSH configuration, least-privilege access, and closing known vulnerabilities to an agreed timeline.

Terraform: Infrastructure provisioning as code.

Ansible: Configuration management and automation.

Azure: Working depth in the equivalent services, and judgement about what belongs where when a client runs more than one platform.

GCP: Relevant where a client workload sits there.

Kubernetes: Running and securing orchestrated containers in production, where a project uses them.

SIEM and SOAR: Security event collection and response tooling. Prior experience is welcome; where you do not have it, this capability is developed in the role with support.

Education

A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is considered on the same terms.

description:

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early\-career to mid\-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer\-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production\-grade solution delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure, deploy, and support AI\-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP\-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
* Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
* Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
* Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.
* Working knowledge of data protection fundamentals, including data discovery and classification, DLP concepts, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.
* Experience with at least some of the following tools/platforms: Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, VS Code with AI extensions, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Cyera, Varonis, Sentra, CrowdStrike Falcon DSPM, Wiz DSPM, Microsoft Purview, Python, TensorFlow.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset, structured communication, and comfort working in client\-facing delivery environments. Field engineering patterns from Microsoft and AI FDE patterns from the market both strongly emphasize technical depth plus customer communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, DSPM, CASB, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, encryption, or privacy engineering.
* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

* Typical work environment
* Global, cross\-functional teams

title: ET SIC Reporting Analyst
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**ET SIC Reporting Analyst**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. Fueled by a US$1\.5\+B investment in technology and innovation, EY is primed to guide clients in their efforts to drive sustainable growth, create new value, and build new and better ways of working. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The role**
 SIC Reporting Analyst is responsible for supporting vulnerability management reporting for ET (excluding Platform Mgmt) and providing accurate, timely and actionable compliance insights.
   

  

 This position requires close collaboration with global teams across ET, Infosec and business functions to align reporting with the broader risk frameworks. The analyst will be responsible for monitoring progress against vulnerability mgmt goals, validating that vulnerabilities are remediated or approved plans are recorded within defined SLA targets, and providing compliance status through regular assessments, on\-going leadership reviews and real\-time dashboards.
   

  

 As part of the role, the individual will assess existing reporting processes, refine them as business needs change, and work closely with Infosec and other stakeholders to strengthen data quality, reporting controls and governance models within Enterprise Technology. The ideal candidate brings relevant experience in IT risk reporting, governance and analytics, contributing to EY’s overall risk management plan.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As the SIC Reporting Analyst, the key responsibilities would include:
   

  

* Prepare and maintain Global Vulnerability mgmt compliance reports for all in\-scope IT functions within Enterprise Technology (excluding Platform Mgmt), including GRAC reporting for in\-scope I\&O functions.
* Consolidate vulnerability, remediation and exception data from approved sources; validate completeness and accuracy before reports are published.
* Monitor compliance within agreed SLA’s as established by Infosec, tracking remediation progress, overdue items and adherence to security policies.
* Prepare weekly / monthly SIC updates and leadership review materials to provide clear insights into vulnerability mgmt performance.
* Maintain reporting definitions, templates, calculation logic and documented controls to enable consistent and repeatable reporting.
* Collaborate with Infosec and I\&O product managers to understand reporting requirements, source\-data changes and future product road maps.
* Maintain end\-to\-end reporting views for vulnerabilities across ET (excluding Platform Management), including remediation plans, exceptions, approvals and closure status.
* Work closely with Infosec and stakeholders within ET to provide reporting support for Critical Vulnerability Response Plan (CVRP) exercises.
* Produce vulnerability management dashboards, scorecards, trend analysis and actionable insights for operational and leadership reviews.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and act as a reporting conduit between Infosec, Product/Application, Engineering, Operations \& Management; follow up on data gaps and unresolved ownership issues.
* Provide segmented reporting and follow\-up views for Data Restricted Countries (DRCS) and Local Support teams (excluding Platform Management).
* Identify, assess and highlight risk trends, ageing, recurring issues and priority remediation areas for I\&O (excluding Platform Mgmt).
* Compliance Management: Support reporting that demonstrates whether in\-scope portfolios for I\&O adhere to GCoC recommended policies, compliances, regulations and standards.
* Identify opportunities to automate and standardize data preparation, validation, dashboard refresh and recurring report distribution.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experienced in managing key Stakeholder relationships, including Senior Management.
* Good understanding of Industry GRAC, vulnerability mgmt standards and compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of other Risk domains such as Operations Risk Management, IT Security and Cyber Risks, with the ability to interpret and report these risks.
* Good working knowledge of IT Operations, IT practices and operational reporting.
* Can work with minimum direction and deliver timely, accurate and high\-quality results.
* High integrity; dedicated to excellence; highly attentive to details; flexible. Possesses sound Project Management and coordination skills.
* Self\-motivated, with ability to work independently, as well as with other stakeholders in a collaborative manner.
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Experience in working with multiple stakeholders at different levels of the organization, including senior management.
* Excellent communication skills, especially related to facilitation, documentation and reporting
* Coordination skills and the ability to leverage support from other parts of the organization.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Education:**
* Bachelor or Master’s degree in Information Technology / Engineering


**Experience:**
* 6 \- 9\+ years of relevant experience in IT risk, vulnerability management, compliance reporting, data analytics or Service Delivery


**What We Look For**
* Thought leadership
* Strategic Thinking
* Automation \& standardization
* Relationship Management
* Interpersonal \& Influencing skills
* Good communication skills
* Data\-driven decision making

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Engage and contribute to the Identity \& Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 5\-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages\- Python, JSON, Ruby, C\#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud\-native/cloud\-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5\-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification


**Certifications:**
* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur


**What We Look For**
* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands\-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

title: EndPoint Infrastructure Patching And Vulnerability Management Administrator
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you.
